job.title: Solutions Integration Engineer II
job.location: Remote – CA, Chicago, Seattle or TX
job.workplace: Remote (US, outside the SF Bay, NYC and Washington, D.C. metro areas)
job.pay_full: $73,780 – $111,600 a year base salary, plus performance-based bonus/variable pay and equity for eligible roles

details.about: Samsara runs the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that helps organisations with physical operations, from trucking and utilities to food production, turn Internet of Things data into insights. In its Professional Services organisation, a Solutions Integration Engineer helps Samsara's most strategic customers design and build B2B integrations with the IoT platform, working with product managers, business operations, sales and systems engineers.
duties: Lead system integration projects with customer development teams, partners and third-party integrators, or build enterprise-grade solutions with Samsara's APIs, webhooks and connectors
Define project scopes, technical specifications and business requirements from design through delivery
Plan complex projects with many people, dependencies and risks, and make delivery commitments
Build scalable integration architecture for real-time data streaming, event subscriptions and batch processing
Build, test, validate and review code, and give actionable code review feedback
Advise on and document integration best practices with Samsara's APIs and products
Work with the Developer Ecosystem team to improve the API experience and features
needs: 5+ years designing and developing integration solutions
Experience gathering data integration requirements and turning them into technical data designs
Able to write, read and understand Python and one other language (for example JavaScript or AppScript)
Proficiency with LLM-based tools for code generation, prompt engineering and automation
Experience with agentic workflows, including designing, orchestrating and deploying multi-agent systems for enterprise use
3+ years hands-on with AWS, Azure or GCP cloud services
Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs/webhooks and modern databases
Experience with customer evaluations and deployments, handling several engagements at once
Proven ability to manage complex projects with stakeholders up to C-level
Strong written communication and presentation skills
GitHub for version control; agile tools such as Jira and Confluence
nice: Knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, SQL and data visualisation
Bachelor's in engineering, computer science or a related field
3+ years customer-facing experience building and supporting enterprise-scale integrations or API scripting
Familiarity with B2B integration projects, fleets and logistics, or vehicle diagnostic systems
details.benefits: Annual base salary $73,780 – $111,600 for full-time employees; the range spans approved pay zones and the one that applies depends on your primary work location, skills and experience. Total compensation combines base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay and equity (for eligible roles). Samsara also lists a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, and comprehensive health and parental leave plans.
notes: Remote role open to US residents outside the San Francisco Bay, New York City and Washington, D.C. metro areas
